sources.licence_notes: Explicitly CC BY 4.0 per the file's own Métadonnées sheet - unlike COD-AB, no licence ambiguity here. One real nuance: the file's own Notes_Methodologiques sheet documents that values from 2015-01 to 2019-12 were reconciled onto the post-2020 base by whoever compiled this dashboard file ('à la demande de l'utilisateur'), using an official coefficient (4.12919) quoted from ICASEES's own bulletin warnings - transparent and internally verified (the note checks continuity at the Dec-2019/Jan-2020 boundary), but it is not clear whether this reconciliation itself carries the same institutional endorsement as the raw monthly bulletins. Raw pre-2020 values are preserved unmodified in the same file's Archive_Base1981_Brute sheet. See docs/verification-debt.md.

Widened 2026-09-12 from the global index (IND1) alone to also cover 3 named COICOP sub-categories (alimentation IND2, santé IND7, transports IND8) and the published Inflation line (IND14) - see docs/verification-debt.md for a real discrepancy found in IND14 (a naive recomputation from IND1 doesn't reproduce it). 9 other COICOP sub-categories (incl.
